full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media drawing shows a close, frontal female face with blue eyes above two overlapping hands, all laid over a collage of printed newspaper or book pages. Pale gray blocks of dense text remain visible across the forehead, cheeks, nose, hands, and lower background, though individual words are too small or disrupted to read. The face fills nearly the entire upper two-thirds of the frame. Heavy black brows and smoky inked lids frame the pale blue irises, which look directly outward. Loose dark hair and scratched charcoal marks close in from both upper corners. The nose descends along the center, but the mouth is almost entirely hidden behind fingers folded across it. One hand runs diagonally from left center toward the right, its dark nail visible near the cheek. The other hand folds beneath it and drops toward the bottom center, where it meets a nearly black mass of shadow or fabric. Across the left and right lower corners, flat mustard-yellow areas interrupt the otherwise monochrome surface, as if paper or paint has been laid beneath the head. Vertical drips and thin black scratches cross these yellow areas, and a curved dark line sweeps upward from the lower right. The face is built from layered printed fragments, gray washes, and forceful black drawn contours rather than smooth photographic skin. Finer hatch marks shape the eyes, cheekbones, knuckles, and fingertips. A few bright unprinted paper areas serve as highlights on the eyelids, nose, and hands. The flat collage has little physical depth; its drama comes from the intense gaze and the hands placed directly in front of it. Light is suggested as a pale frontal illumination, making the central facial planes and fingers brighter while dark hair and the lower shape frame them. The yellow blocks appear flat and luminous, not lit by a separate real source. The overall composition is confrontational and graphic, balancing dense gray text texture and black ink against small blue eyes and bold yellow fields.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒材绘画呈现一张近距离正面的女性脸孔，蓝眼睛下方是两只交叠的手，整幅画铺在印刷报纸或书页拼贴上。浅灰色密集文字块穿过额头、面颊、鼻子、双手和下方背景，单词过小且被打断，无法逐字辨读。脸部几乎填满上方三分之二。浓黑眉毛与烟熏般的墨色眼睑环绕浅蓝色虹膜，目光直向画外。松散深发与刮擦炭笔痕从上方两角逼近。鼻子沿中央向下，嘴则几乎全被交叠在前面的手指遮住。一只手从左中部斜向右侧，可见靠近面颊的一枚深色指甲。另一只手折在下面，向下方中央垂去，接上近黑色的阴影或衣料。左下和右下角，平坦的芥末黄区域打断其余近单色表面，仿佛纸张或颜料铺在头部下方。竖向滴痕和细黑划痕穿过黄色区域，一道弯曲黑线从右下扫向上方。脸部由层叠印刷碎片、灰色水洗痕与有力黑色描线构成，而非平滑摄影皮肤。较细排线塑造眼睛、颧骨、指关节和指尖。少数未印刷的亮纸区域成为眼睑、鼻子和双手的高光。平坦拼贴没有多少真实纵深；张力来自直接凝视的眼睛与横在面前的双手。光被表现为浅色正面照明，使中央面部平面和手指更亮，深发和下方暗块形成边框。黄色块面是平坦而发亮的，并非受另一真实光源照射。整体构图直面观者且图形感强，以密集灰色印字肌理和黑墨平衡少量蓝眼睛与大胆黄色色域。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media drawing overlays dense printed-page texture with expressive charcoal and ink marks. Black, white, and layered grays carry nearly all tonal structure, punctuated by small cool blue details and broad flat mustard-yellow accents. Fine text columns function as texture; their words recede beneath hatching, gray wash, scratches, and strong hand-drawn contours. Smoothness is deliberately interrupted by drips, paper seams, and rubbed or scraped passages. A bold central mass presses close to the frame, while deep corner shadows and high-contrast pale planes organize the gaze. Frontal paper-white highlights define selected forms, and the colored blocks remain graphic rather than volumetric. The overall effect is direct, urban, and emotionally intense, with tactile collage and precise focal details coexisting.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒材绘画把密集印刷书页肌理与富有表现力的炭笔、墨线痕迹叠加。黑、白与层层灰色承担几乎全部明暗结构，少量冷蓝细节和宽阔平坦的芥末黄块面形成点缀。细小文字栏作为肌理存在，字词在排线、灰色水洗、刮痕与有力手绘轮廓下退隐。滴痕、纸张接缝以及磨擦或刮开的区域有意打断平滑感。大胆的中央体块紧贴画框，深色角部阴影与高对比浅色平面引导目光。正面纸白色高光界定少数选定形体，彩色块面则保持图形性而非立体感。整体效果直接、都市化且情绪强烈，触感拼贴与精确的焦点细节并存。
theme_en: A blue-eyed face and folded hands drawn over printed pages with yellow accents
theme_zh: 印刷书页上带黄色重音的蓝眼面孔与交叠双手
name: Loui Jover
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
